_comment: Accepted divergences from the Stitch designs. Each entry is a reviewed decision; anything not listed here fails verify:design-coverage.

allow.heading: Consist #704 Telemetry
allow.reason: Design sample-data vehicle id (a specific train consist). The Stringline & Rolling Stock Telematics section is implemented and renders the line's real schedule-derived fleet facts (station count, headway control, stock kind); the specific consist number is the design mock's data, not app copy.

allow.heading: Line M1 Northbound: Averton Central → Highlands Junction
allow.reason: Design sample-data leg title (fictional Averton line and stops). Every itinerary leg renders the same structure with the app's own data — line name, board → alight stops, ride time — plus an expandable station progression (the design's turnout manifest).

allow.heading: Bus B14: Crosstown Arterial
allow.reason: Design sample-data alert headline. The alert list renders the API's own seeded alerts (title, severity, line) via ServiceAlertCard; the corridor status matrix, commuter alert dispatch panel, and operations dispatch log are implemented around the same real data.

allow.heading: University Quad & Medical Campus #ST-0112
allow.reason: Design sample-data stop name and code. The Pinned Transit Stations section renders the rider's real saved stops from the API; the design's Averton stop names are the mock's data, not app copy.
